quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Video Call Etiquette] Since more meetings happen online, many companies now share simple video call guidelines with new employees. These include muting the microphone when not speaking and looking at the camera rather than the screen, which helps everyone feel more engaged during the conversation.
quests.question: Why are employees encouraged to look at the camera during video calls?
options: It improves the video quality
It is required by the software
It helps everyone feel more engaged
It reduces background noise
quests.correctAnswer: It helps everyone feel more engaged
quests.hint: The reason is explained at the end of the passage.
quests.explanation: The passage says looking at the camera helps everyone feel more engaged during the conversation.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [An Ergonomic Desk Setup] After weeks of neck pain, Diego adjusted his desk so that his monitor sat at eye level and his chair supported his lower back. Within two weeks, the discomfort had almost completely disappeared, convincing him that his old setup had been the real problem all along.
quests.question: What convinced Diego that his old desk setup was the problem?
options: His discomfort almost disappeared after adjusting it
A doctor told him directly
His coworkers had the same pain
He read about it online
quests.correctAnswer: His discomfort almost disappeared after adjusting it
quests.hint: Look at what happened within two weeks of the change.
quests.explanation: The passage says his discomfort nearly disappeared after the adjustment, which convinced him the old setup was the cause.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Public Transit Pass] The city's new monthly transit pass allows unlimited rides on buses and trains for a flat fee, which works out cheaper than paying per trip for anyone who commutes more than twice a day. Officials hope the pass will encourage more residents to leave their cars at home.
quests.question: Who benefits most from the flat monthly fee, according to the passage?
options: People who only travel on weekends
Anyone who commutes more than twice a day
Tourists visiting for a few days
Drivers who rarely use public transit
quests.correctAnswer: Anyone who commutes more than twice a day
quests.hint: The comparison to per-trip pricing is explained in the first sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says the flat fee is cheaper for anyone who commutes more than twice a day.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Flexible Work Hours Policy] Under the company's new policy, employees may start their workday anytime between seven and ten in the morning, as long as they complete eight hours. Managers report that the change has not affected productivity, and several employees say it has made balancing childcare far easier.
quests.question: What have several employees said about the new policy?
options: It has increased their workload
It has made balancing childcare easier
It has confused their schedules
It has reduced their pay
quests.correctAnswer: It has made balancing childcare easier
quests.hint: The employees' reaction is described in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says employees have found the policy makes balancing childcare much easier.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Composting at Home] Starting a compost bin at home is simpler than many people expect: fruit scraps, coffee grounds, and dry leaves can all be layered together and turned occasionally with a shovel. Within a few months, the mixture breaks down into rich soil that can be used in a garden.
quests.question: What happens to the mixture after a few months?
options: It must be thrown away
It needs to be replaced entirely
It attracts unwanted insects
It breaks down into rich soil
quests.correctAnswer: It breaks down into rich soil
quests.hint: The outcome is described in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says the mixture breaks down into rich soil after a few months.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Peer Tutoring Program] The high school's peer tutoring program pairs older students strong in a subject with younger students who are struggling in that same class. Teachers say the arrangement benefits both sides, since tutors often understand the material more deeply after explaining it to someone else.
quests.question: Why do tutors benefit from the program, according to teachers?
options: They receive extra credit automatically
They are excused from homework
They get to choose their own classes
They understand the material more deeply after explaining it
quests.correctAnswer: They understand the material more deeply after explaining it
quests.hint: The reason tutors benefit is explained in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says tutors understand material more deeply after explaining it to someone else.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Board Game Café] The new café downtown charges a small entry fee that gives customers access to a wall of over three hundred board games, along with free tea and coffee refills. Owners say the model encourages people to stay longer and try games they would never buy for themselves.
quests.question: What does the entry fee give customers access to?
options: A private gaming room only
One free game to keep
Over three hundred board games and free drink refills
A monthly game subscription
quests.correctAnswer: Over three hundred board games and free drink refills
quests.hint: The details of the entry fee are listed in the first sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says the fee includes access to over three hundred games and free tea and coffee refills.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Neighborhood Watch Group] After a few minor break-ins last spring, residents on Maple Street formed a neighborhood watch group that shares updates through a group chat. quests.question: What do residents credit for the drop in incidents?
options: New security cameras
Increased awareness
A stronger police presence
Better street lighting
quests.correctAnswer: Increased awareness
quests.hint: The residents' explanation is given in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says residents credit increased awareness, not any single event, for the drop in incidents.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Family Budget Meeting] Once a month, the Delgado family sits down together to review their spending and set goals for the next few weeks. Even their ten-year-old son joins the discussion, which his parents say has taught him the value of saving before buying something he wants.
quests.question: What has the family budget meeting taught the ten-year-old son?
options: The value of saving before buying something
How to invest in stocks
How to open a bank account
How to earn extra money
quests.correctAnswer: The value of saving before buying something
quests.hint: The lesson is described in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says the meetings have taught the son the value of saving before making a purchase.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Community Supported Agriculture Box] By joining a community supported agriculture program, the Reyes family now receives a box of seasonal vegetables from a local farm every week. Because the produce is picked only a day or two before delivery, they say it tastes noticeably fresher than what they used to buy at the supermarket.
quests.question: Why does the family think their vegetables taste fresher now?
options: The farm uses special fertilizer
The vegetables are always organic
The box includes recipe cards
The produce is picked only a day or two before delivery
quests.correctAnswer: The produce is picked only a day or two before delivery
quests.hint: The reason is given right before the comparison to the supermarket.
quests.explanation: The passage explains that the vegetables taste fresher because they are picked just before delivery.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Cloud Storage Backup] After losing years of family photos when her laptop broke, Yuna now backs up all her files automatically to a cloud storage service every night. She says the small monthly fee feels worth it, knowing her memories would never be lost the same way again.
quests.question: Why does Yuna think the monthly fee is worth it?
options: The service is completely free
It makes her laptop run faster
It lets her share files publicly
Her memories would never be lost the same way again
quests.correctAnswer: Her memories would never be lost the same way again
quests.hint: Her reasoning is explained in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says Yuna feels the fee is worth it because her memories are now protected.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Physical Therapy Recovery] After knee surgery, Robert attended physical therapy twice a week for three months. His therapist warned him that recovery would feel slow at first, but gradual, consistent exercise would rebuild his strength far better than resting completely.
quests.question: What did Robert's therapist warn him about?
options: Recovery would feel slow at first
Surgery would need to be repeated
Exercise could damage his knee further
He would never fully recover
quests.correctAnswer: Recovery would feel slow at first
quests.hint: The warning is stated in the second sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says the therapist warned Robert that recovery would feel slow at first.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Travel Insurance Claim] When her flight was cancelled due to a strike, Beatriz filed a claim with her travel insurance company for the cost of an extra hotel night. The company approved her claim within a week, since strikes were clearly listed as a covered reason for delays.
quests.question: Why was Beatriz's claim approved?
options: She had never filed a claim before
Strikes were listed as a covered reason for delays
The hotel contacted the company directly
Her flight was the airline's newest route
quests.correctAnswer: Strikes were listed as a covered reason for delays
quests.hint: The reason for approval is explained in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says the claim was approved because strikes were a covered reason for delays.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [An Employee Satisfaction Survey] This year's employee survey showed that while most staff felt satisfied with their salaries, many wanted clearer paths for career growth within the company. In response, managers are now required to hold career development conversations with each employee twice a year.
quests.question: What did many employees want more of, according to the survey?
options: Higher salaries
More vacation days
Shorter work hours
Clearer paths for career growth
quests.correctAnswer: Clearer paths for career growth
quests.hint: Distinguish what employees were satisfied with from what they wanted more of.
quests.explanation: The passage says many employees wanted clearer paths for career growth, even though most were satisfied with pay.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Wildlife Crossing Bridge] To reduce the number of animals killed on the highway, engineers built a wide bridge covered in plants that allows deer and other wildlife to cross safely above the traffic. Since it opened, wildlife-related accidents in the area have dropped by more than half.
quests.question: What effect has the wildlife bridge had?
options: Traffic has slowed down significantly
More animals have moved into the area
Wildlife-related accidents have dropped by more than half
Drivers now take a longer route
quests.correctAnswer: Wildlife-related accidents have dropped by more than half
quests.hint: The result is stated in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says wildlife-related accidents have dropped by more than half since the bridge opened.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Study Abroad Program] Students who join the university's semester-abroad program often say their biggest challenge was not the coursework but adjusting to daily life in a new culture. quests.question: What do advisors do to help students prepare?
options: Assign extra coursework before departure
Hold a workshop to set realistic expectations
Pair students with local host families only
Require a language exam before leaving
quests.correctAnswer: Hold a workshop to set realistic expectations
quests.hint: The advisors' action is described in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says advisors hold a preparation workshop to help set realistic expectations.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Live Streaming Gamer] Priya streams herself playing video games online three evenings a week, answering viewer questions in real time through a chat window. What started as a hobby now earns her a small income through viewer donations and short advertisement breaks.
quests.question: How does Priya's streaming now earn her money?
options: Through a fixed salary from a company
Through selling her own games
Through viewer donations and advertisement breaks
Through ticket sales to live events

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Subscription Box Service] Each month, subscribers to the snack box service receive a curated selection of treats from a different country, along with a small card explaining each item's origin. quests.question: What is the company's stated goal for the service?
options: To offer the cheapest snacks available
To replace grocery shopping entirely
To promote only local products
To turn snacking into a way of learning about cultures

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [Blended Family Holiday Plans] Now that their families have blended, Carmen and her husband alternate which side they visit for the winter holidays each year, a system that took a few years to feel fair to everyone involved. This year, the children are especially excited because it is her side's turn.
quests.question: Why are the children especially excited this year?
options: It is Carmen's side's turn for the holidays
They are visiting a new country
Both sides are joining together

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Physical Therapist's Posture Advice] A physical therapist explained that most desk-related back pain comes not from sitting itself, but from staying in one position for too long without moving. She recommends standing up and stretching for at least two minutes every half hour, regardless of how busy the workday feels.
quests.question: According to the therapist, what actually causes most desk-related back pain?
options: Sitting in a chair at all
Using a computer screen
Staying in one position for too long
Poor lighting in the office
quests.correctAnswer: Staying in one position for too long
quests.hint: The therapist's explanation contrasts two possible causes early in the passage.
quests.explanation: The passage says the therapist identified staying in one position too long, not sitting itself, as the real cause.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Fitness App Challenge] The fitness app's thirty-day challenge encourages users to complete a short daily workout and log their meals, awarding badges for consistency rather than performance. Developers say this approach keeps beginners motivated, since progress is measured by effort instead of results.
quests.question: Why do developers say the badge system keeps beginners motivated?
options: Badges can be exchanged for prizes
Only expert users receive badges
Progress is measured by effort instead of results
Badges are awarded once a year
quests.correctAnswer: Progress is measured by effort instead of results
quests.hint: The developers' reasoning is explained in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says the badges reward effort rather than results, which keeps beginners motivated.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Public Transit Expansion] After years of public requests, the city council approved funding to extend the subway line to the eastern suburbs, a project expected to take four years to complete. quests.question: What do supporters say the expansion will give residents?
options: Lower housing prices in the suburbs
Free parking near the subway
Shorter working hours
A practical alternative to driving downtown

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Four-Day Work Week Trial] During a six-month trial, one company reduced its work week to four days without cutting employee pay. quests.question: What happened to productivity during the trial, according to the passage?
options: It increased sharply
It dropped noticeably
It stayed the same
It could not be measured

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Cultural Etiquette Tip] Travel guides often remind visitors that in many cultures, it is considered polite to remove one's shoes before entering someone's home, even if the host does not mention it directly. options: It is required by law in most countries
It shortens the length of a visit
It leaves a lasting positive impression on hosts
It is only expected from tourists
quests.correctAnswer: It leaves a lasting positive impression on hosts
quests.hint: The effect of the custom is described in the last sentence.
quests.explanation: The passage says following this custom often leaves a lasting positive impression on local hosts.

quests.passage: [A Beach Cleanup Event] Volunteers at last weekend's beach cleanup collected over four hundred kilograms of trash in just three hours, with plastic bottles and cigarette butts making up the largest share. quests.question: Why do organizers plan to hold the event quarterly?
options: To raise more money for charity
To keep the beach cleaner year-round
To attract more tourists
To train new volunteers faster

options: Social media
Lower vendor fees
A bigger festival location
Government funding

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [A Scholarship Interview] Before her scholarship interview, Fatima practiced answering questions about her goals with a career counselor, who reminded her that specific examples usually impress interviewers more than general statements. options: Specific examples usually impress interviewers more than general statements
Interviewers prefer short, simple answers
Practicing alone is more effective
Confidence matters more than content
quests.correctAnswer: Specific examples usually impress interviewers more than general statements

quests.explanation: The passage says the counselor advised Fatima that specific examples impress interviewers more than general statements.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct answer.
quests.passage: [An Escape Room Business] When Tobias opened his escape room business, he assumed horror-themed rooms would be the most popular. Mystery rooms consistently sold out faster than horror rooms
Both themes sold equally well
Customers preferred shorter rooms overall
quests.correctAnswer: Mystery rooms consistently sold out faster than horror rooms

quests.explanation: The passage says the data showed mystery rooms sold out faster, which surprised Tobias's original assumption.

quests.passage: [A Digital Detox Challenge] For one week, Layla's family agreed to leave their phones in a drawer between six in the evening and eight the next morning. quests.question: What did family members realize by the end of the week?
options: They often reached for their phones out of habit
Phones were essential for their jobs
The challenge was impossible to complete
They needed phones for emergencies only

quests.question: What makes this summer different for Mateo, according to the passage?

He is learning woodworking for the first time
His grandfather is teaching someone else instead
They are building a much larger project

quests.hint: The change this summer is described in the last sentence.
